topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: The words spill across the paper, a map of secrets I never knew were charted. Each line a new path, leading deeper into a wilderness of thoughts I thought only I carried. Shadows grow longer, the air chills with each page turned. What once was ours, now feels borrowed, a story told without me. The room narrows, the world outside blurs into a distant memory. I reach out, but the words are cold, distant, already belonging to someone else.
